rules.description: A public IP address / internet gateway is enabled, exposing compute to the public internet.
rules.recommendation: Confirm inbound access is required. Restrict inbound rules to specific source ranges and management ports only.

rules.description: An inbound rule allows traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 (any source).
rules.recommendation: Replace the wildcard CIDR with the smallest specific source range required for the lab.

rules.description: A management port (SSH 22 or RDP 3389) is open to a broad source range.
rules.recommendation: Limit management-port access to known source addresses, or use a bastion / just-in-time access pattern.

rules.description: Password authentication is selected for a VM where key-based authentication is available.
rules.recommendation: Prefer SSH public-key authentication for Linux VMs. Ensure any password is supplied via a secure parameter, never embedded.

rules.description: A potential secret was detected in a free-text field or initialisation script.
rules.recommendation: Remove the secret. Use a secure parameter or a runtime secret store. Templates must never contain credentials.

rules.description: Object storage has public access enabled.
rules.recommendation: Block public access unless the lab explicitly requires anonymous access, and document the justification.

rules.description: A required supporting resource is not present, which will likely cause the deployment to fail.
rules.recommendation: Include the required supporting resources. Missing networking is a common cause of VM / EC2 deployment failures.

rules.description: Custom (Classification F) fragments were added and are not validated against official evidence.
rules.recommendation: Manually review the custom fragments for correctness, security, and duplicate identifiers before deployment.
